metadata.coordinate_processing: New roads: HK1980 geographic to WGS84 (EPSG:4611 to EPSG:4326). Existing roads pinned by stable ROUTE_ID to the retained source snapshot; over 400 shared sections validate the datum within 2.5 cm. Connected endpoints checked after conversion.
metadata.note: Original XY preserved in approximate local metre coordinates. ELEVATION is a relative road level, not metres. Depth 32 m, widths (6 m elevated carriageways; 12 m at the low Hung Hing / Tonnochy approach), 5.6 m tunnel interior and 7 m elevated decks with cosine ramps over 150 m outside shared level junction aprons are authored. Aprons extend until adjoining centreline branches separate by 7.5 m. Shorelines derive from LandsD iB1000 with recorded gap repairs. Turn restrictions are not inferred.
